name: dev.leclap/mcp
title: LeClap
description: Compose and render video from one JSON template. Deterministic, runs locally, no generative model.

environmentVariables.name: LECLAP_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory rendered videos are written to. Defaults to ~/.leclap/renders.

environmentVariables.name: LECLAP_MCP_MEDIA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Allowlisted directory the server may read source media from. Defaults to ~/.leclap/media.

environmentVariables.name: LECLAP_MCP_RENDER_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-render timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 600000.

environmentVariables.name: LECLAP_MCP_ALLOW_REMOTION
environmentVariables.description: Opt in to the Remotion clip renderer, which executes local JavaScript. Off by default.

environmentVariables.name: LECLAP_MCP_REMOTION_ENTRY
environmentVariables.description: Path to a Remotion entry point used by render_remotion_clip when it is enabled.

tools.name: ping
tools.description: Health check that returns a fixed readiness string.

tools.name: get_template_schema
tools.description: Return the authoritative template descriptor JSON Schema plus the authoring guide.

tools.name: validate_template
tools.description: Validate a template without rendering and report the clips and fields compose_video will require.

tools.name: compose_video
tools.description: Render a template to an MP4 with FFmpeg and return the output path.

tools.name: probe_media
tools.description: Inspect a local media file and report its streams, duration, and dimensions.

tools.name: render_remotion_clip
tools.description: Render a composition from your own Remotion project to an MP4. Gated — see notes.

dev.leclap.mcp.notes: render_remotion_clip is registered only when LECLAP_MCP_ALLOW_REMOTION is set, because it executes caller-supplied local JavaScript.
